subject: Embeddings + Rerank onboarding: index backfill strategy and evaluation cadence
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma@searchplus.ai>
To: alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Embeddings + Rerank onboarding: initial questions

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the intro earlier. We want to get a concrete plan in place for moving our search stack to Redwood's embedding + rerank flow. High level context: SearchPlus has ~1.2M active content items (docs + product pages), daily delta ~2k, currently using Pinecone + a custom reranker on CPU. Goal is to cut latency and cost while improving relevance for typed queries.

Three quick asks up front:
- Backfill approach: we need options for a low-downtime backfill (dual-index, shadow indexing, or rolling reindex). We need to understand the tradeoffs and a recommended path for a production cutover.
- Vector DB compatibility: we currently prefer an open-source store (Milvus) running in our VPC. Can Redwood support Milvus or do you recommend your hosted vectorstore?
- Rerank evals: we have ~5k labeled queries but want a recommended smoke/acceptance test (metrics + thresholds) for rollout.

I've attached a small profile export (first 10k rows) and a short constraints doc. Can you and your team propose a week-by-week onboarding cadence and a short checklist for production acceptance? Target launch window: Q4 (end of October ideally).

Thanks,
Emma Liu
Head of Search Product
SearchPlus

[Attachment: searchplus_data_profile.csv (CSV)]

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma@searchplus.ai>
Cc: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Embeddings + Rerank onboarding: initial questions

Hi Emma — thanks for the data sample and context. Looping in Monica (CS) and Karthik (SE) so we can sync on technical constraints. Below is a pragmatic approach we use successfully across similar customers; I put the high-level plan first and then specific notes on the three asks.

Proposed high-level approach (3 phases, 6 weeks recommended for initial cutover):
1) Sampling & evaluation (1 week): sample build, embed with candidate models, run rerank evals on labeled set.
2) Shadow indexing & dual-read (2–3 weeks): build new index in parallel, validate at scale, run live-rerank comparisons on a % of traffic.
3) Cutover & backfill (2 weeks): incremental backfill with rolling traffic shift + post-cut acceptance.

Backfill options & tradeoffs:
- Dual-index (recommended): build new index in parallel; route a small percentage of queries to the new pipeline for A/B quality checks. Minimal downtime, easier rollback.
- Shadow indexing + periodic sync: lower immediate cost but longer validation window.
- Full offline reindex (fastest build, potential staleness): faster indexing if you can tolerate a maintenance window.

Vector DB compatibility:
- Redwood Private supports VPC-hosted deployments and can run with Milvus in your VPC (we've done this with a few customers). If you prefer our hosted vectorstore, we can offer managed snapshots and a faster operational experience. We'll map the chosen store to our caching and prefix-KV strategy to minimize cold-query latency.

Rerank eval recommendations (smoke -> acceptance):
- Smoke: MRR@10 on labeled set, recall@10, and sample manual pass/fail on 50 queries.
- Acceptance: NDCG@10 and MRR improvement >= 5% over baseline OR no >2% negative regression on core queries; P95 latency under 350ms for rerank path.

Immediate asks for us to proceed:
- Share S3 credentials/sample ACL for a 100k export (we'll only read).
- Confirm if Milvus in-VPC is required or if hosted store is acceptable.

I've attached an initial migration outline with roles, week-by-week tasks, and a rough cost delta. Can we schedule a 30-minute kickoff to align? I've included a calendly link below; Monica will propose an ops checklist after the call.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com

[Attachment: initial_migration_outline.xlsx]
Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcMockDrive

From: Emma Liu <emma@searchplus.ai>
To: alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@searchplus.ai
Date: 2026-08-30T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Embeddings + Rerank onboarding: initial questions

Alex — thanks, that approach is helpful. A couple of constraints from our side:
- Procurement requires that the vector store runs in our AWS VPC (Milvus preferred).
- We have an internal policy requiring list of data flows and a short SOC2 mapping before any hosted indexing can start; procurement attached the requirements.
- We will provide a 100k sample export to the S3 path once access is confirmed.

Can Redwood run the shadow indexing (Milvus in our VPC) and still use Redwood's rerank models and monitoring? What's the operational model for KV/prefix caching when vectorstore is VPC-hosted?

Emma
Head of Search Product, SearchPlus

[Attachment: procurement_requirements.pdf]

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma@searchplus.ai>
Cc: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-30T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Embeddings + Rerank onboarding: initial questions

Emma — short answers first: yes, we can operate with Milvus in your VPC for indexing and retrieval while running our rerank models in a private deployment. Our integration pattern is:

- Vectorstore-in-VPC: Milvus handles nearest-neighbor search; we run a small Redwood Private agent in your VPC that performs batching, prefix/KV caching, and serves a deterministic interface to our rerank service.
- Rerank + monitoring: rerank models can run in the same VPC or in a dedicated Redwood cluster with secure TLS tunnels; monitoring & acceptance metrics are streamed to your account workspace (no raw data leaves your control plane unless you opt in).

Operational notes on caching & latency:
- We recommend a warm-up window where we keep a small persistent cache for hot prefixes (helps P95).
- For delta ingestion we support incremental upserts to minimize reindex churn.

Proposed rerank acceptance thresholds (suggested):
- MRR@10: >= baseline +5% OR no regression > 2% on core queries
- NDCG@10: increase or stable within 1.5%
- Latency: P95 for rerank path < 350ms (load dependent)
- If thresholds fail, automatic rollback to baseline model + incident triage.

I'll attach a small rerank evaluation template and sample scripts we use for NDCG calculation. Next steps we recommend: schedule kickoff (30m), provide S3 read-only, and confirm Milvus-in-VPC requirement. Monica will follow with an operational mutual action plan.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: rerank_eval_template.csv]

Hi Emma — following up to propose a concrete mutual action plan we can confirm on the kickoff. Suggested kickoff slots: Tue 2026-09-07 10:00 or Wed 2026-09-08 14:00 PT (I've shared a Calendly link below if neither works).

Mutual action plan (high level)
- Week 0 (prep): S3 access + procurement doc review; security questions answered (Procurement owner: procurement@searchplus.ai).
- Week 1 (sample & smoke): Redwood runs sampling, builds candidate embeddings, runs smoke rerank on 5k labeled queries. Deliverable: smoke report (MRR, recall, failure cases).
- Week 2–3 (shadow index): Build Milvus index in your VPC; run dual-read for 10% of traffic; compare production vs candidate. Deliverable: dual-read comparison dashboard + call to review.
- Week 4 (acceptance & cutover): Incremental backfill of remaining items; run acceptance evals, finalize cutover window. Deliverable: signed acceptance checklist and rollback runbook.

Immediate asks for today:
1) Confirm preferred kickoff slot or pick from Calendly (https://calendly.com/redwood-onboarding/30min)
2) Provide the S3 path and IAM read-only role for the 100k sample
3) Confirm Milvus-in-VPC is required (yes/no) so we can size agents and networking

I'll prepare a short ops checklist (ingest keys, index config, eval notebook) and share before the call. Looking forward to partnering.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
